## 功能描述 / Feature Description

简洁清晰地描述你希望的功能 / A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## 问题背景 / Problem Statement

描述你遇到的问题或痛点 / Describe the problem or pain point this feature would solve.

例如：我总是在使用 [...] 时感到困扰，因为 [...]
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## 建议的解决方案 / Proposed Solution

描述你希望的解决方案 / A clear description of what you want to happen.

## 替代方案 / Alternatives Considered

描述你考虑过的其他替代方案 / A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 使用场景 / Use Cases

描述这个功能的使用场景 / Describe the use cases for this feature.

1. 场景 1...
2. 场景 2...

## 设计建议 / Design Suggestions

如果有的话，提供设计思路或界面草图 / If applicable, provide design ideas or UI mockups.

## 附加信息 / Additional Context

添加任何其他有关功能请求的上下文或截图 / Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
